name: zcode-web
description: Self-hosted web UI for the ZCode CLI agent — chat, sessions and projects in your browser, CLI local or in Docker.

scripts.serve:test: mkdir -p .e2e-home/cli && cp tests/fixtures/cli-config.json .e2e-home/cli/config.json && ZCODE_WEB_TOKEN=e2e-token ZCODE_CLI_ENTRY=$PWD/scripts/fake-cli.mjs ZCODE_WORKSPACE_ROOT=$PWD/.e2e-ws ZCODE_HOME=$PWD/.e2e-home ZCODE_ENABLE_FILES=1 ZCODE_ENABLE_GIT=1 PORT=${E2E_PORT:-3472} HOST=127.0.0.1 node server/index.js
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix web run build && npx --prefix web playwright test --config web/playwright.config.ts
